title: Figures 107-108: Cylinder CFD Mach number at 900 mph and pressure at 1100 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of a flat-ended cylinder at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. Captions read "Figure 107. Cylinder Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 900 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" (low-speed wake within a supersonic field) and "Figure 108. Cylinder Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 1100 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" (bow shock ahead of the front face, in Pa). Attachment III, page 137 of the BAASS report.
